messages:
Mike: Heads-up — Helix Prod is running into response deltas when switching from CompetitorX -> Redwood. They flagged prompt parity, tokenization differences, and security questionnaire items. Need plan for POC + pricing note.
Anya: Can you paste a couple of the failing prompts? even short ones help.
Mike: sure — here are examples they said diverged most: 
```
1) summarize: 'Summarize the following 2k-char policy doc in 6 bullets'
2) customer style: 'Reply in formal tone, include action items and deadlines'
```
Priya: For the security questionnaire — they asked about KMS, data residency, and audit logs. We can offer Private deploy or Dedicated. Which one are they leaning to?
Mike: Enterprise legal wants VPC options but their engineers want a quick POC on Hosted API first to validate output parity.
Sam: For parity tolerance, what's their SLA on exact match vs acceptable delta? we should ask for an acceptance threshold (e.g., semantic similarity score >= 0.85 or manual pass/fail on 50 evals).
Anya: Good point. Ask them for a short eval set (~30 prompts) with expected outputs or acceptability criteria. We can run our eval harness and share diffs.
Eli: Billing question from them: during POC, will we charge Hosted usage or offer trial credits + reserved rate if they flip to Dedicated? I suggest free credits for 2 weeks + a discounted committed rate if they convert within 30 days.
Mike: @Eli yes, propose: free Hosted credits up to 500k tokens, plus 25% off first 3 months of Dedicated if they commit. Need approvals?
Eli: I'll ok the credit promo. For Dedicated discount need finance sign-off but likely fine for ARR motion.
Priya: On KMS/audit: we should send Helix our standard security pack and highlight the Private option for keys-in-customer-KMS. Also offer a short SOC/ISO summary.
Sam: Technical notes — main migration pain points: tokenization differences causing truncation, role/assistant system prompt handling, and minor temperature/seeding differences. Recommendation:
- Provide mapping shim for system/assistant -> function call fields
- Normalize tokenization by sending canonicalized input: `normalize_unicode -> trim_whitespace -> explicit eos`
- Run side-by-side eval and flag top-5 divergences for manual triage
Anya: Can we spin up a dedicated test endpoint with model variant parity + fallback to a cheaper variant for cost simulation?
deploy-bot: created test_endpoint/helix-parity-2026 with model=rwd-3.1-compat, retention=7d
Mike: Nice. Action items: 1) Mike -> ask Helix for 30 eval prompts + acceptance criteria (today) 2) Anya -> run eval harness on endpoint and share diff sheet (tomorrow) 3) Priya -> send security pack & KMS options (EOD) 4) Eli -> confirm billing promo and draft POC quote (today)
Priya: I'll also flag any network ACL items for Private option.
Sam: I'll prepare a short playbook for prompt shim + sample mapping snippet:
```json
{
  "competitor_input": "user_text",
  "redwood": {
    "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"user_text"}],
    "max_tokens": 1024
  }
}
```
Anya: 👍 will attach eval report and recommend prompt edits where necessary.
Mike: Thanks team. I'll loop in Helix contacts and post their eval set here once they send it. :thumbsup:
